messages:
Alex W: Kicking off a short POC acceptance sync with FinCloud. They want clear latency/cost/quality targets and confirmation we can support customer-managed KMS/HSM + VPC. Quick plan?
Maria R: FYI customer asks: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 400ms for single-turn prompts up to 512 tokens. Throughput target: 30 rps sustained, 100 rps burst. Cost target ~ $0.20–$0.25 / 1k tokens.
Samir K: Those latency numbers are aggressive but achievable on Dedicated with the quantized 13B variant and tuned kernels. Hosted may be ~20–40% slower. Need model name, seq length distribution, and confirm they accept 8-bit/4-bit quant.
Julie C (CS): Security checklist from their side: customer-managed KMS (in their AWS account), HSM option, SOC2 report, VPC peering or Private deployment, and max data retention 30 days. Also want export-control and data residency notes. I have onboarding doc.
Alex W: They referenced a "llama-like 13B" open model. They want deterministic evals: run ~5k prompt set + human review. Proposed timeline: 3 weeks: Week1 infra + onboarding, Week2 eval runs, Week3 tuning + acceptance.
Samir K: For the eval harness we'll hand them a small runner. Example snippet to run locally: ```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key="<REDACTED>")
# batch eval: set batch_size=8, enable_prefix_cache=True
``` We'll provision a test cluster with caching enabled.
Maria R: Pricing question: which is better for POC — hosted pay-as-you-go with trial credits or short Dedicated reserved for predictability? They also asked about a short-term burst pricing option.
Julie C (CS): Recommend hosted trial with committed credit for initial POC (gives control over burn). If they require network isolation or KMS-in-account, move to Dedicated/Private. Offer a 2-week burst window for load testing.
Samir K: Proposed acceptance checklist (draft):
- Latency: p50 <= 120ms, p95 <= 400ms (512 tokens)
- Throughput: 30 rps sustained, 100 rps burst (<=10s)
- Quality: automated evals (5k prompts) + human spot-check; structured EM >= 75%, semantic sim >= 0.80, human pass rate >= 90%
- Cost: average <= $0.22 / 1k tokens during POC
- Security: customer-managed KMS + VPC/Private deployment + SOC2 attestation
- Data: retention <= 30 days, no model fine-tuning on customer data without explicit consent
- Reliability: automatic fallback to smaller quant model if latency targets missed for >5m
Alex W: Slight tweak on quality: for structured outputs require 75% exact match and for free-text use cosine(sim) > 0.8 aggregated over eval set.
Maria R: They also want per-request tracing and cost tags. Redwood Console can emit per-request traces and export to Datadog/Snowflake. I'll attach a dashboard template.
Presales Bot: Deploy job started: creating test cluster 'pc-185100' in us-east-1 (ETA ~18m).
Julie C (CS): Security note: customer wants KMS keys in their account — supported. Ops will need a cross-account IAM role + onboarding checklist; I'll share docs (KMS onboarding, SOC2 scan).
Samir K: Quick burn estimate for a conservative POC: assume avg request 300 tokens. If we run avg 5 rps for 8h/day over 5 days => tokens = 216M -> cost @ $0.22/1k ≈ $47.5k. With caching + sampling we can likely reduce effective tokens by ~80% -> ~$9.5k. We'll present both scenarios.
Alex W: Action items:
- Samir K: validate model perf on quantized 13B and produce perf matrix + recommended config (due in 48h).
- Maria R: confirm final acceptance wording and cost target with customer, clarify expected traffic profile (24h vs business hours) (due 24h).
- Julie C (CS): drop KMS onboarding doc, SOC2 attestation PDF, and VPC peering steps into the shared folder (EOD).
- Alex W: run Thursday sync with customer to confirm timeline and acceptance checklist.
Maria R: Thanks team — I'll ping FinCloud now and loop in their infra lead for the KMS bit. :thumbsup:
